run_triangulation_test: run the TriangulationTest suite to verify 3D point triangulation from multiple camera views
test_triangulate_with_plane_constraint: test triangulation using a planar constraint to recover a 3D point from a single viewpoint
test_triangulate_with_distortions: test triangulation with camera distortion parameters to verify accurate 3D point recovery
test_triangulate_from_pixels: test triangulation directly from pixel measurements without projecting a known 3D point
test_triangulate_error_cases: test triangulation error handling for duplicate viewpoints, single observations, and points behind cameras
